name: Sagar Darshan Atithigruh Dining Hall
why_it_matters: The Shree Somnath Trust's own atithigruh dining hall, right next to the main temple with a sea-facing terrace. Thali sits around ₹170 with rotating Gujarati + Punjabi mains; pilgrims rate it the best value-for-money option after morning darshan.
insider_tip: Lunch service runs ~11.30 AM-2.30 PM only; if you're on Veraval-side bypass after 3 PM the kitchen's closed. Booking the atithigruh stay gets you priority seating during festival weekends.
signature_address: Sagar Darshan Atithigruh, adjacent to Somnath Mahadev Mandir, Somnath, Gir Somnath 362268

name: Blue Coriander (Lords Inn Somnath)
signature_dish: Pure-veg multi-cuisine fine-dine with breakfast buffet
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor's #1-ranked Somnath restaurant (3.7/5, ~72 reviews) — Lords Inn's in-house multi-cuisine kitchen, open 7 AM-11 PM, with the only proper fine-dine ambience in town. The fallback when you've done thali for three meals straight.
insider_tip: Sits on the Veraval-Somnath bypass, ~2-3 km from the temple — not walking distance. Reserve ahead at 7-9 PM dinner slot when temple-circuit groups roll in.
signature_address: Lords Inn Somnath, Veraval-Somnath Bypass Road, Somnath, Gir Somnath 362268

name: Hotel Somnath Sagar AC Restaurant
signature_dish: Authentic Kathiyawadi + Gujarati à la carte and buffet
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor's #4 Somnath restaurant (3.8/5, ~46 reviews) — in-house AC restaurant at Hotel Somnath Sagar, opposite Shubham Departmental Store beside Somnath Railway Station. The closest 'a la carte + buffet' option for groups arriving on the overnight train from Ahmedabad.
insider_tip: Best for arrival lunch when you've just stepped off the train — 5-minute walk from the station, AC respite from the bypass heat. Group bookings should call ahead for the buffet rate.
signature_address: Hotel Somnath Sagar, Somnath Bypass Road Corner, opposite Shubham Departmental Store, beside Somnath Railway Station, Somnath 362268

name: Hotel Sun Plaza Restaurant
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor #7 with 32 reviews, ~2 km from Somnath Temple and 1.2 km from Somnath Railway Station. The hotel houses a Honest Restaurant outlet (the Ahmedabad-rooted pure-veg chain), giving it a brand-quality floor most local hotels can't match.
insider_tip: If the in-house multi-cuisine is full, the Honest outlet on the same property is the better pick — same pricing, more consistent for paneer/pav-bhaji style cravings.
signature_address: Somnath Bypass Corner, P Patan, Somnath, Gir Somnath 362268

name: Bhabha Restaurant
why_it_matters: Opposite Leelavati Bhavan near Somnath bus station — a long-running Gujarati-Kathiyawadi thali hall used by the bus-circuit pilgrim crowd. Listed on Zomato + Justdial with consistent traffic; not glamorous but the cheapest sit-down within 5 minutes of the bus stand.
insider_tip: Note the spelling — listed locally as 'Bhabha' (not 'Bhabhi'); easier to find on Justdial. Order Kathiyawadi thali over standard Gujarati for the heat-of-Saurashtra masala edge.
signature_address: Opposite Leelavati Bhavan, near Bus Station, Prabhas Patan, Somnath, Veraval 362268

name: Surbhi Hotel & Restaurant
signature_dish: North + South Indian veg at reasonable prices
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor's current top-rated Somnath restaurant by score (4.1/5) — pitched as 'standard North and South Indian at reasonable prices'. Sits on the Somnath-Veraval bypass opposite Hotel Fern, useful as a non-thali dinner option for groups.
insider_tip: Smaller review count (~9 on Tripadvisor) means it's still a local-traffic place — call the kitchen ahead of 9 PM if you want South Indian; dosas slow down after dinner rush.
signature_address: Opposite Fern Hotel, Somnath-Veraval Bypass, Prabhas Patan, Somnath 362268
